title.value: Diagnostic tests for infections in critically ill immunocompromised patients
title.justification: The editorial focuses on the diagnostic challenges and strategies for managing infections in critically ill immunocompromised patients.
title.quote: Diagnostic tests for infections in critically ill immunocompromised patients

analysis.description: The paper discusses the challenges in diagnosing infections among immunocompromised patients in intensive care. It highlights the complexity due to varying immune deficiencies and emphasizes the need for precise diagnostic tools to differentiate between infectious and non-infectious conditions in such patients.

type.justification: The paper discusses various empirical approaches and tools used for the diagnosis of infections in critically ill immunocompromised patients, citing different diagnostic strategies and studies.
type.quote: An effective diagnostic approach requires integrating multimodal information, including the type of immune deficit, clinical and radiologic presentations, pathogen-focused techniques, and biomarkers of host response.

name.justification: The paper primarily focuses on the diagnostic strategies in intensive care settings, particularly for immunocompromised patients.
name.quote: These differential diagnoses are made difficult in immunocompromised intensive care unit (ICU) patients.

name.justification: The paper focuses on the diagnosis of infections, using various diagnostic tools and methods, for immunocompromised patients.
name.quote: Gaps in diagnosing infection in immunocompromised patients
